state.contract_text: <full extracted text of the 30-80 page vendor contract, including any amendments/exhibits>

governing_law.instructions: From the governing law / choice of law clause in state.contract_text, identify which jurisdiction's law governs the agreement.

criteria.other_us_state: A US state other than Delaware, California, New York, or Texas
criteria.other_non_us: A non-US jurisdiction other than England/Wales, Ireland, or Singapore
criteria.not_specified: No governing law clause is present or the jurisdiction is not stated

auto_renewal.instructions: Determine whether the contract automatically renews for additional term(s) unless a party affirmatively gives notice not to renew.

criteria.true: The contract contains an evergreen/auto-renewal clause that extends the term by default
criteria.false: The contract expires at the end of the stated term unless the parties affirmatively agree to renew, or no renewal mechanism is present

renewal_notice_period_band.instructions: If auto-renewal applies, find the notice period a party must give before the renewal date to stop the contract from auto-renewing.

criteria.none_or_na: No auto-renewal, so no notice period applies
criteria.under_30_days: Notice period is less than 30 days
criteria.over_90_days: Notice period is more than 90 days
criteria.not_specified: Auto-renewal applies but no notice period is stated

liability_cap_present.instructions: Determine whether the contract includes a limitation of liability clause that caps one or both parties' total liability.

criteria.true: A clause caps total liability at a stated amount or formula
criteria.false: No liability cap is present, or liability is expressly stated as unlimited

liability_cap_amount_band.instructions: If a liability cap is present, classify the cap amount relative to fees paid under the contract.

criteria.under_1x_annual_fees: Cap is less than one year's fees
criteria.one_x_annual_fees: Cap is equal to approximately one year's fees
criteria.two_to_3x_annual_fees: Cap is between roughly two and three times annual fees
criteria.over_3x_annual_fees: Cap is more than three times annual fees
criteria.fixed_dollar_amount: Cap is a fixed dollar amount unrelated to fees paid
criteria.unlimited_for_certain_claims: Cap is unlimited for specific carve-out claims (e.g. confidentiality, IP, gross negligence) even if capped generally
criteria.not_specified: A cap is present but its amount or formula cannot be determined

liability_cap_mutual.instructions: If a liability cap is present, determine whether it applies mutually to both the vendor and the customer, as opposed to protecting only the vendor.

criteria.true: The cap (and its carve-outs) applies equally to both parties
criteria.false: The cap applies only to one party, or no cap is present

indemnity_scope.instructions: Determine the scope of indemnification obligations in the contract.

criteria.ip_infringement_only: Indemnity is limited to third-party IP infringement claims
criteria.confidentiality_breach_only: Indemnity is limited to breaches of confidentiality/data protection obligations
criteria.general_broad: Indemnity broadly covers general third-party claims arising from the agreement, owed by one party
criteria.mutual_broad: Both parties owe each other broad general indemnification
criteria.not_specified: An indemnity reference exists but its scope cannot be determined

dpa_present.instructions: Determine whether the contract includes data processing terms governing the handling of personal data (a standalone DPA, an exhibit, or a data protection clause in the body).

criteria.true: Data processing / data protection terms covering personal data handling are present
criteria.false: No data processing terms are present

termination_for_convenience.instructions: Determine whether either party may terminate the contract for convenience (without cause) before the end of the term.

criteria.true: At least one party has a right to terminate without cause on notice
criteria.false: Termination is only permitted for cause (e.g. breach, insolvency), or not at all before term end

termination_notice_band.instructions: If termination for convenience is available, find the notice period required to exercise it.

criteria.under_30_days: Notice period is less than 30 days
criteria.over_90_days: Notice period is more than 90 days
criteria.not_specified: The right exists but the notice period is not stated

payment_terms_band.instructions: Identify the standard invoice payment terms stated in the contract.

criteria.due_on_receipt: Payment is due immediately or on receipt of invoice
criteria.net_15: Payment due within 15 days of invoice
criteria.net_30: Payment due within 30 days of invoice
criteria.net_45: Payment due within 45 days of invoice
criteria.net_60: Payment due within 60 days of invoice
criteria.net_90_or_more: Payment due in 90 or more days
criteria.milestone_based: Payment is tied to milestones/deliverables rather than a fixed invoice term

consequential_damages_excluded.instructions: Determine whether the contract excludes consequential, indirect, special, or punitive damages.

confidentiality_survival.instructions: Determine whether the confidentiality obligations are stated to survive termination or expiration of the agreement.

criteria.true: The contract explicitly states confidentiality obligations survive termination/expiration
criteria.false: No survival language for confidentiality is present, or there is no confidentiality clause

ip_ownership.instructions: Determine who owns intellectual property in deliverables/work product created under the contract.

criteria.vendor_retains_all_ip: The vendor retains ownership of all IP, granting the customer only a license
criteria.customer_owns_deliverables: The customer owns IP in deliverables created specifically for it
criteria.work_for_hire: Deliverables are explicitly designated work made for hire owned by the customer
criteria.joint_ownership: IP in deliverables is jointly owned by both parties
criteria.not_specified: No IP ownership clause is present or ownership cannot be determined

assignment_consent_required.instructions: Determine whether the contract requires the other party's prior written consent before a party may assign the agreement.

criteria.true: Assignment requires the other party's prior consent (subject to customary carve-outs like M&A/affiliates)
criteria.false: Assignment is freely permitted, or no assignment clause is present

exclusivity_present.instructions: Determine whether the contract grants exclusivity to either party (e.g. sole-source vendor commitment, exclusive territory or category).

non_solicitation_clause.instructions: Determine whether the contract includes a non-solicitation clause restricting hiring/soliciting the other party's employees.

insurance_requirements_present.instructions: Determine whether the contract requires either party to maintain specified insurance coverage.

criteria.true: Minimum insurance coverage requirements are specified

sla_present.instructions: Determine whether the contract includes a service level agreement or uptime/performance commitment.

criteria.true: Specific service levels, uptime, or performance metrics are committed to
criteria.false: No service level commitments are present

sla_credits_present.instructions: If an SLA is present, determine whether the contract provides service credits or similar remedies for missed service levels.

criteria.true: Missed service levels entitle the customer to credits, refunds, or a defined remedy
criteria.false: No such remedy is provided, or there is no SLA

audit_rights_present.instructions: Determine whether either party has a contractual right to audit the other party's records, security, or compliance.

criteria.true: An audit right is granted to at least one party

force_majeure_present.instructions: Determine whether the contract includes a force majeure clause excusing performance for events beyond a party's control.

criteria.true: A force majeure clause is present
criteria.false: No force majeure clause is present

dispute_resolution_method.instructions: Identify the primary mechanism the contract designates for resolving disputes.

criteria.litigation_courts: Disputes are resolved through litigation in courts
criteria.binding_arbitration: Disputes are resolved through binding arbitration
criteria.not_specified: No dispute resolution mechanism is specified

warranty_disclaimer_level.instructions: Assess how broadly the contract disclaims warranties on the vendor's products/services.

contract_term_length_band.instructions: Identify the length of the initial contract term.

criteria.under_1_year: Initial term is less than 1 year
criteria.over_3_years: Initial term is more than 3 years
criteria.perpetual_or_indefinite: The contract has no fixed end date
criteria.not_specified: The initial term length cannot be determined
